title: Logos added for Google Fi, Visible and Straight Talk
details: From each carrier's own website. Google Fi shows its Fi symbol, which reads better at small sizes than the full wordmark.

title: 3 carriers added: Xfinity Mobile, Spectrum Mobile and Straight Talk
details: Added Xfinity Mobile Plus, Spectrum Unlimited Plus and Straight Talk Silver, Gold and Platinum Unlimited. Xfinity and Spectrum plans need their home internet. Prices are not yet verified on the carriers' sites.

title: Logos added for Cricket, Metro and US Mobile
AT&T prices corrected
details: AT&T's 2.0 plans are $15 higher at 1 line than our first figures: Value 2.0 $55, Extra 2.0 $75, Premium 2.0 $95, Elite 2.0 $115 (with AutoPay).

title: T-Mobile plans renamed to 2.0
details: Essentials, Experience More and Experience Beyond are now the 2.0 versions. Apple TV is now $3/mo, no longer included.

title: Verizon Unlimited Ultimate hotspot raised
details: Hotspot is 200GB (then unlimited at 6 Mbps), up from the 60GB we first listed.

title: Google Fi Unlimited Standard data raised
details: 50GB of high-speed data and 25GB of hotspot.

details: Verizon Simplicity, Google Fi Unlimited Premium, Visible, Cricket Select Unlimited, Boost Unlimited Premium, Metro $40 Period and US Mobile Unlimited Starter.

details: 27 of 28 plans were checked against the carriers' own websites. Mint couldn't be checked.
